newsitem.title: USA: AMBAC Q4 new issue muni market share rises.
newsitem.headline: AMBAC Q4 new issue muni market share rises.

text.p: AMBAC Inc said AMBAC Indemnity's new issue municipal market share was about 26 percent in the 1996 fourth quarter compared to 24 percent a year ago, according to estimates based on industry sources.
AMBAC Indemnity's new issue municipal market share for the full year 1996 was about 29 percent compared to about 25 percent in 1995, AMBAC said.
AMBAC Indemnity insured $13.0 billion in par value bonds during the fourth quarter of 1996, an increase of 27 percent from the $10.2 billion insured in the fourth quarter of 1995, AMBAC said.
